def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if valid_mask.any():
        priority_scores[valid_mask] = np.exp(-remaining[valid_mask]) * bins[valid_mask]
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    ideal_capacity = 0.8 * bins.mean() if bins.size > 0 else 1.0
    mask = bins >= item
    scores = np.zeros_like(bins)
    if not mask.any():
        return scores
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    relative_utilization = (bins[mask] - remaining) / bins[mask]
    deviation_from_ideal = np.abs(remaining - ideal_capacity)
    scores[mask] = 1 / (deviation_from_ideal + 1e-12)
    return scores
